rca_of_issue.bug: Player dots cannot be dragged to new positions in customize mode
reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate to Tactics Board from home
2. Click CUSTOMIZE button next to PITCH VIEW
3. Verify button changes to DONE and gold borders appear (✓ works)
4. Attempt to drag any player dot to new position
5. Player dot does not move - remains in original position
rca_of_issue.root_cause: React Native PanResponder in PitchView.tsx (lines 46-65) does not capture mouse drag events in Expo web preview. The onPanResponderMove Animated.event (lines 52-54) is never triggered. PanResponder is designed for native touch events and requires proper web polyfilling. Current implementation uses useNativeDriver:false which is correct, but the gesture recognition itself (onMoveShouldSetPanResponder threshold of 3px at line 50-51) may not be detecting web mouse movements.
evidence: DOM inspection shows transform never changes from matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)
Bounding box coordinates remain identical before and after drag attempt
No console errors - gesture simply not recognized
All other Animated.View features work (gold border transitions)
potential_solutions: Option 1: Add web-specific mouse event handlers (onMouseDown, onMouseMove, onMouseUp) alongside PanResponder
Option 2: Use react-native-gesture-handler which has better web support
Option 3: Use conditional web/native implementation with Platform.OS check
Option 4: Implement drag with plain pointer events for web: onPointerDown/Move/Up
rca_of_issue.impact: HIGH - Core feature non-functional in web preview, though may work on native devices
